<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Entraînement Tactique</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0c0f0d;
    --panel:#141815;
    --panel-2:#1b201c;
    --line:#2a322c;
    --text:#e8ece7;
    --muted:#8a948b;
    --accent:#c8a24a;
    --accent-dim:#7a672f;
    --danger:#b23a2f;
    --ok:#4a7a4f;
    --mono: "Courier New", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
    --sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;}
  html,body{margin:0; padding:0; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:var(--sans); height:100%; overflow-x:hidden;}
  button{font-family:inherit;}
  #app{min-height:100vh; min-height:100dvh; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}

  /* ---------- CONFIG SCREEN ---------- */
  .topbar{
    padding:18px 20px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px;
  }
  .topbar h1{font-size:15px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; margin:0; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent);}
  .topbar .sub{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.05em;}

  #config{flex:1; padding:14px 14px 100px; max-width:720px; margin:0 auto; width:100%;}

  .block{background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:12px; overflow:hidden; transition:border-color .15s, opacity .15s;}
  .block.active{border-color:var(--accent-dim);}
  .block.locked{opacity:.38; pointer-events:none;}
  .block.special{border-color:#4a5a3a;}
  .block-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;
    padding:13px 15px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none;
  }
  .block-head-left{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px;}
  .block-title{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase;}
  .block-desc{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px;}
  .block-body{padding:0 15px 15px; display:none;}
  .block.open .block-body{display:block;}
  .chev{color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; transition:transform .15s;}
  .block.open .chev{transform:rotate(90deg);}

  .toggle{
    position:relative; width:40px; height:22px; border-radius:11px; background:#31382f;
    border:1px solid var(--line); flex:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, opacity .15s;
  }
  .toggle.on{background:var(--accent-dim);}
  .toggle.locked{opacity:.35; pointer-events:none;}
  .toggle::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:2px; left:2px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%;
    background:#9aa398; transition:transform .15s, background .15s;
  }
  .toggle.on::after{transform:translateX(18px); background:var(--accent);}

  .wcard{border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 12px; margin:10px 0;}
  .wcard.off{opacity:.55;}
  .wcard-head{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .wcard .chip{padding:6px 11px;}
  .wlabel{font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); margin:8px 0 2px;}
  .trow{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin:4px 0; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .tbtn{padding:6px 10px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:transparent; color:inherit; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer;}
  .tbtn:active{transform:scale(.96);}
  .wtests{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:8px;}
  .chip-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin:10px 0 4px;}
  .chip{
    padding:8px 13px; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel-2);
    font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; user-select:none; transition:.12s;
  }
  .chip.on{color:#0c0f0d; font-weight:700; border-color:transparent;}
  .chip[data-color="Rouge"].on{background:#c0453a;}
  .chip[data-color="Bleu"].on{background:#3a6fc0;}
  .chip[data-color="Vert"].on{background:#4a9a52;}
  .chip[data-color="Jaune"].on{background:#d4b23c;}
  .chip[data-color="Orange"].on{background:#d4813c;}
  .chip[data-color="Violet"].on{background:#9a5cc0;}
  .chip[data-color="Noir"].on{background:#141414; color:#eee; border:1px solid #5a5a5a;}
  .chip[data-color="Blanc"].on{background:#eae7dd; color:#141712;}
  .chip:not([data-color]).on{background:var(--accent);}

  .miniall{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--accent); text-decoration:underline; cursor:pointer; margin-left:auto;}

  .field-row{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; padding:9px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-size:12.5px;}
  .field-row:first-child{border-top:none;}
  .field-label{color:var(--text);}
  .field-help{color:var(--muted); font-size:10.5px; margin-top:1px;}
  .field-row input[type=number]{
    width:64px; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text);
    padding:6px 7px; border-radius:6px; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; text-align:center;
  }
  input[type=range]{accent-color: var(--accent); flex:1;}
  .rangeval{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--accent); width:38px; text-align:right;}

  .subnote{font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:8px 10px; margin-top:10px;}

  .segmented{display:flex; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;}
  .segmented > div{flex:1; text-align:center; padding:9px 4px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--muted); background:var(--panel-2);}
  .segmented > div.on{background:var(--accent-dim); color:var(--text); font-weight:700;}
  .segmented > div + div{border-left:1px solid var(--line);}

  .time-input{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:var(--mono);}
  .time-input input{width:44px; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); padding:6px; border-radius:6px; text-align:center; font-family:var(--mono);}

  .savebar{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .savebar input[type=text]{flex:1; min-width:120px; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); padding:8px 10px; border-radius:7px; font-size:12px;}
  .btn{background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); padding:8px 13px; border-radius:7px; font-size:12px; cursor:pointer;}
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.97);}
  .btn.primary{background:var(--accent); color:#141712; font-weight:700; border-color:var(--accent);}
  .btn.ghost{background:transparent;}
  .savedlist{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; margin-top:8px;}
  .saveditem{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:7px; padding:7px 10px; font-size:12px;}
  .saveditem .name{font-family:var(--mono);}
  .saveditem .acts{display:flex; gap:6px;}
  .saveditem .acts span{cursor:pointer; color:var(--accent); font-size:11px;}
  .saveditem .acts span.del{color:var(--danger);}

  .footerbar{
    position:fixed; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; padding:14px 16px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    background:linear-gradient(0deg, var(--bg) 60%, transparent); display:flex; justify-content:center;
  }
  .startbtn{
    width:100%; max-width:690px; padding:16px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--accent);
    background:var(--accent); color:#141712; font-size:14px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .startbtn:active{transform:scale(.985);}

  /* ---------- SESSION SCREEN ---------- */
  #session{
    position:fixed; inset:0; background:#000; display:none; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; z-index:50; transition:background-color .25s ease;
  }
  #session.live{display:flex;}
  .sess-top{width:100%; padding:20px 20px 0; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start;}
  .sess-timer{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:20px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); letter-spacing:.05em;}
  .sess-status{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.35); text-align:right; line-height:1.6; white-space:pre-line;}
  .sess-exercise{display:none; text-align:center; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); padding:8px 0 0;}
  .sess-exercise.show{display:block;}
  .sess-center{flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; padding:20px;}
  .sess-word{
    font-size:13vw; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase;
    text-align:center; text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }
  .sess-word.small{font-size:9vw;}
  .sess-hint{position:absolute; top:14px; left:0; right:0; text-align:center; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.3); letter-spacing:.15em;}
  .sess-bottom{width:100%; padding:0 18px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); display:flex; gap:10px;}
  .sess-btn{
    flex:1; padding:15px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
  }
  #session.paused .sess-center{opacity:.25;}
  .pausecard{
    position:absolute; padding:22px 30px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25); border-radius:12px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.55); font-family:var(--mono); letter-spacing:.15em; color:#fff; font-size:13px; display:none;
  }
  #session.paused .pausecard{display:block;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0px;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">

  <div class="topbar">
    <div>
      <h1>Entraînement Tactique</h1>
      <div class="sub">100% hors-ligne · configuration de séance</div>
    </div>
    <div class="sub" id="statusline">prêt</div>
  </div>

  <div id="config">

    <!-- DIFFICULTÉ -->
    <div class="block open" data-block="difficulty">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('difficulty')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Niveau de difficulté</div>
            <div class="block-desc" id="difficultyLabel">Moyen</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="segmented" id="difficultySeg">
          <div data-diff="facile" onclick="setDifficulty('facile')">Facile</div>
          <div class="on" data-diff="moyen" onclick="setDifficulty('moyen')">Moyen</div>
          <div data-diff="difficile" onclick="setDifficulty('difficile')">Difficile</div>
        </div>
        <div class="subnote">
          Facile : intervalles longs et réguliers, pas de leurres, pas de cibles multiples, une seule couleur à la fois.<br>
          Moyen : fatigue progressive et leurres occasionnels, intervalles modérés.<br>
          Difficile : cibles multiples activées par défaut, intervalles resserrés, temporisations plus courtes.<br>
          Choisir un niveau règle automatiquement les modules Fatigue / Leurres / Cibles multiples — modifiables ensuite manuellement.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CIBLES / COULEURS -->
    <div class="block open active" data-block="colors">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('colors')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle on" id="tg-colors" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('colors')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Cibles / Couleurs</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Annonces de couleurs à engager</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="chip-row" id="colorChips">
          <span class="miniall" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleAllChips('colorChips', state.colorsSelected)">tout sélectionner</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Intervalle entre annonces</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="colorMin" value="15" min="2" max="120"> – <input type="number" id="colorMax" value="25" min="2" max="120">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field-label">Volume voix</div>
          <input type="range" id="volVoice" min="0" max="100" value="100" oninput="syncRangeLabel('volVoice')">
          <div class="rangeval" id="volVoiceVal">100%</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SONS DE TIR -->
    <div class="block open active" data-block="shots">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('shots')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle on" id="tg-shots" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('shots')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Sons de tir</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Armes, coup par coup, rafales enchaînées</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="field-help" style="margin-top:6px;">Pour chaque arme : active-la, choisis coup par coup et/ou rafale, coche les pistes sonores voulues, et teste avec ▶ avant de valider.</div>
        <div id="weaponCards"></div>
        <div class="subnote">
          Coup par coup : un seul tir, ou parfois trois d'affilée (toujours sonorisé par la version synthétique). Rafale : une des pistes cochées, ou parfois deux rafales enchaînées, de la même arme ou d'une autre arme à rafale activée. Pompe et sniper : en « rafale » ils enchaînent 2 à 3 tirs.
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Pause entre tirs</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="shotMin" value="4" min="1" max="60"> – <input type="number" id="shotMax" value="10" min="1" max="60">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Chance de 3 coups d'affilée</div><div class="field-help">en mode coup par coup</div></div>
          <input type="range" id="chainSingle" min="0" max="100" value="35" oninput="syncRangeLabel('chainSingle')" style="max-width:110px;">
          <div class="rangeval" id="chainSingleVal">35%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Chance d'enchaîner 2 rafales</div><div class="field-help">même arme ou arme différente</div></div>
          <input type="range" id="chainBurst" min="0" max="100" value="30" oninput="syncRangeLabel('chainBurst')" style="max-width:110px;">
          <div class="rangeval" id="chainBurstVal">30%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field-label">Volume tirs</div>
          <input type="range" id="volShots" min="0" max="100" value="80" oninput="syncRangeLabel('volShots')">
          <div class="rangeval" id="volShotsVal">80%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div>
            <div class="field-label">Spatialisation (gauche / droite)</div>
            <div class="field-help">S'applique uniquement aux tirs — jamais aux annonces ou aux ordres</div>
          </div>
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-spatial" onclick="toggleFlag('spatial')"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ORDRES DE MOUVEMENT -->
    <div class="block" data-block="orders">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('orders')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-orders" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('orders')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Ordres de mouvement</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Postures, immobilisation et déplacements</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="chip-row" id="orderChips">
          <span class="chip on" data-order="couche">Couché</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="genoux">À genoux</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="accroupi">Accroupi</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="fige">Ne pas bouger</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="avancer">Avancer</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="reculer">Reculer</span>
          <span class="chip on" data-order="bouger">Bouger / changer de position</span>
        </div>
        <div class="subnote">
          Couché / à genoux / accroupi restent compatibles avec une annonce de couleur simultanée.<br>
          « Ne pas bouger » bloque les annonces de couleur pendant sa durée (son continu discret en fond marquant début/fin) — un tir peut survenir pendant ce temps, à vous de juger si vous étiez à couvert.<br>
          Avancer / reculer / bouger bloquent aussi les annonces de couleur (mais pas les tirs) et utilisent une plage de temps dédiée, plus longue, pour laisser le temps physique de se déplacer.
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field-label">Temporisation aléatoire (postures)</div>
          <div class="toggle on" id="tg-randomHold" onclick="toggleFlag('randomHold')"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Durée de maintien (postures)</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="holdMin" value="3" min="1" max="60"> – <input type="number" id="holdMax" value="15" min="1" max="60">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Durée d'exécution (avancer / reculer / bouger)</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max, 5 s minimum recommandé</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="moveMin" value="5" min="1" max="60"> – <input type="number" id="moveMax" value="10" min="1" max="60">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Intervalle entre ordres</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="orderMin" value="15" min="2" max="120"> – <input type="number" id="orderMax" value="20" min="2" max="120">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CIBLES MULTIPLES -->
    <div class="block" data-block="multi">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('multi')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-multi" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('multi')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Cibles multiples</div>
            <div class="block-desc">2 à 3 couleurs annoncées à traiter dans l'ordre</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="subnote">
          Vient se mélanger aux cibles simples : de temps en temps, au lieu d'une seule couleur, une séquence de 2 à 3 couleurs à engager dans l'ordre. Actif par défaut en mode Difficile, désactivable manuellement.
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Fréquence des cibles multiples</div><div class="field-help">% de chance à chaque annonce (le reste : cible simple)</div></div>
          <input type="range" id="multiFreq" min="10" max="100" value="40" oninput="syncRangeLabel('multiFreq')" style="max-width:110px;">
          <div class="rangeval" id="multiFreqVal">40%</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Temps de battement après la séquence</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="multiBattMin" value="5" min="1" max="60"> – <input type="number" id="multiBattMax" value="10" min="1" max="60">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- FATIGUE -->
    <div class="block" data-block="fatigue">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('fatigue')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-fatigue" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('fatigue')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Fatigue progressive</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Escalade automatique pendant la séance</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="subnote">
          Toutes les 30 secondes, la difficulté augmente de 10% (intervalles réduits, part de rafale accrue, fréquence des leurres et densité des cibles augmentées), jusqu'à un plafond de +90%. Désactivé = intensité stable du début à la fin.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- LEURRES -->
    <div class="block" data-block="decoys">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('decoys')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-decoys" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('decoys')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Leurres</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Fausses annonces de couleur, indépendantes</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Fréquence de base</div><div class="field-help">% de chance par minute</div></div>
          <input type="range" id="decoyFreq" min="0" max="60" value="15" oninput="syncRangeLabel('decoyFreq')" style="max-width:110px;">
          <div class="rangeval" id="decoyFreqVal">15%</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- RECHARGEMENT -->
    <div class="block" data-block="reload">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('reload')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-reload" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('reload')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Rechargement</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Signal périodique — mimer le geste avant de réagir</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Intervalle entre signaux</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="reloadMin" value="10" min="2" max="120"> – <input type="number" id="reloadMax" value="25" min="2" max="120">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="subnote">Bloque brièvement les annonces de couleur le temps de mimer le rechargement.</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- BLESSURES SIMULÉES -->
    <div class="block" data-block="injuries">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('injuries')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-injuries" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('injuries')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Blessures simulées</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Contrainte physique temporaire à mimer</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="chip-row" id="injuryChips">
          <span class="miniall" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleAllChips('injuryChips', state.injuriesSelected)">tout sélectionner</span>
        </div>
        <div class="subnote">
          Annonce une zone touchée à mimer (main, bras, jambe ou œil, gauche ou droite) pendant une durée donnée. Bloque les annonces de couleur pendant sa durée, comme les ordres de mouvement.
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Intervalle entre blessures</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="injuryMin" value="30" min="5" max="300"> – <input type="number" id="injuryMax" value="30" min="5" max="300">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Durée de la blessure</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="injuryDurMin" value="30" min="5" max="300"> – <input type="number" id="injuryDurMax" value="30" min="5" max="300">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- AMBIANCE SONORE -->
    <div class="block" data-block="ambiance">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('ambiance')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-ambiance" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleModule('ambiance')"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Ambiance sonore</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Bruits de fond en boucle, faible volume</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="chip-row" id="ambianceChips">
          <span class="miniall" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleAllChips('ambianceChips', state.ambianceSelected)">tout sélectionner</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div class="field-label">Volume ambiance</div>
          <input type="range" id="ambianceVol" min="0" max="100" value="30" oninput="syncRangeLabel('ambianceVol')">
          <div class="rangeval" id="ambianceVolVal">30%</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PRÉPARATION PHYSIQUE -->
    <div class="block special" data-block="prep">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('prep')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div class="toggle" id="tg-prep" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); togglePrepPhysique()"></div>
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Préparation physique</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Séries d'exercices + cibles — désactive les autres modules</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="subnote">
          Une fois activé, désactive automatiquement les tirs, ordres classiques, leurres, fatigue, rechargement et blessures simulées. Le module Couleurs reste actif (obligatoire) et l'Ambiance sonore reste disponible en option.
        </div>
        <div class="chip-row" id="prepChips">
          <span class="miniall" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleAllChips('prepChips', state.prepExercisesSelected)">tout sélectionner</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Durée d'une série</div><div class="field-help">secondes</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="prepSeriesDur" value="40" min="10" max="600">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <div><div class="field-label">Intervalle des annonces pendant la série</div><div class="field-help">secondes, min – max</div></div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="prepColorMin" value="10" min="3" max="120"> – <input type="number" id="prepColorMax" value="15" min="3" max="120">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MODE TEMPS -->
    <div class="block" data-block="time">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('time')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Durée de séance</div>
            <div class="block-desc" id="timeModeLabel">Mode continu</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="segmented" id="timeSeg">
          <div class="on" data-timemode="continu" onclick="setTimeMode('continu')">Continu</div>
          <div data-timemode="chrono" onclick="setTimeMode('chrono')">Chronométré</div>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row" id="chronoRow" style="display:none;">
          <div class="field-label">Durée</div>
          <div class="time-input">
            <input type="number" id="chronoMin" value="5" min="1" max="120"> min
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- CONFIGURATIONS SAUVEGARDÉES -->
    <div class="block" data-block="save">
      <div class="block-head" onclick="toggleBlock('save')">
        <div class="block-head-left">
          <div>
            <div class="block-title">Configurations</div>
            <div class="block-desc">Sauvegarder / recharger</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chev">▸</div>
      </div>
      <div class="block-body">
        <div class="savebar">
          <input type="text" id="saveName" placeholder="Nom de la configuration">
          <button class="btn" onclick="saveConfig()">Enregistrer</button>
        </div>
        <div class="savedlist" id="savedList"></div>
        <div class="savebar" style="margin-top:14px;">
          <button class="btn ghost" style="flex:1;" onclick="resetConfig()">Reset — configuration vierge</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div>

  <div class="footerbar">
    <button class="startbtn" onclick="startSession()">Démarrer la session</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ---------- SESSION SCREEN ---------- -->
<div id="session">
  <div class="sess-hint" id="sessHint">EN ATTENTE</div>
  <div class="sess-top">
    <div class="sess-timer" id="sessTimer">∞</div>
    <div class="sess-status" id="sessStatus">fatigue: —</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sess-exercise" id="sessExercise"></div>
  <div class="sess-center">
    <div class="sess-word" id="sessWord"></div>
    <div class="pausecard">PAUSE</div>
  </div>
  <div class="sess-bottom">
    <button class="sess-btn" id="pauseBtn" onclick="togglePause()">Pause</button>
    <button class="sess-btn" onclick="quitSession()">Quitter</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   ÉTAT / CONFIG
   ========================================================= */
const ALL_COLORS = ["Rouge","Bleu","Vert","Jaune","Orange","Violet","Noir","Blanc"];
const AMBIANCE_KEYS = ["vent","mer","circulation","animaux"];
const AMBIANCE_LABELS = { vent:"Vent", mer:"Mer", circulation:"Circulation", animaux:"Animaux" };
const PREP_EXERCISES = ["pompes","squats","tractions"];
const PREP_LABELS = { pompes:"Pompes", squats:"Squats", tractions:"Tractions" };
const INJURY_KEYS = ["main_g","main_d","bras_g","bras_d","jambe_g","jambe_d","oeil_g","oeil_d"];
const INJURY_LABELS = {
  main_g:"Main gauche touchée", main_d:"Main droite touchée",
  bras_g:"Bras gauche touché", bras_d:"Bras droit touché",
  jambe_g:"Jambe gauche touchée", jambe_d:"Jambe droite touchée",
  oeil_g:"Œil gauche touché", oeil_d:"Œil droit touché"
};
const PREP_LOCKED_OFF = ['shots','orders','fatigue','decoys','reload','injuries'];

const state = {
  modules: { colors:true, shots:true, orders:false, fatigue:false, decoys:false, multi:false, reload:false, ambiance:false, injuries:false },
  flags: { spatial:false, randomHold:true },
  prepPhysique: false,
  colorsSelected: new Set(["Rouge","Bleu","Vert","Jaune"]),
  shotCfg: defaultShotCfg(),
  ordersSelected: new Set(["couche","genoux","accroupi","fige","avancer","reculer","bouger"]),
  ambianceSelected: new Set(["vent","mer"]),
  injuriesSelected: new Set(INJURY_KEYS),
  prepExercisesSelected: new Set(["pompes","squats","tractions"]),
  timeMode: "continu",
  chronoMinutes: 5,
  difficulty: "moyen",
};

/* ---------- chip builders (couleurs / ambiance / exercices) ---------- */
function buildChips(containerId, items, selectedSet, labelMap, dataAttr){
  const wrap = document.getElementById(containerId);
  items.forEach(key=>{
    const el = document.createElement('span');
    el.className = 'chip' + (selectedSet.has(key) ? ' on' : '');
    el.dataset[dataAttr] = key;
    el.textContent = labelMap ? labelMap[key] : key;
    el.onclick = ()=>{
      el.classList.toggle('on');
      if(el.classList.contains('on')) selectedSet.add(key); else selectedSet.delete(key);
    };
    wrap.appendChild(el);
  });
}
buildChips('colorChips', ALL_COLORS, state.colorsSelected, null, 'color');
buildChips('ambianceChips', AMBIANCE_KEYS, state.ambianceSelected, AMBIANCE_LABELS, 'amb');
buildChips('prepChips', PREP_EXERCISES, state.prepExercisesSelected, PREP_LABELS, 'ex');
buildChips('injuryChips', INJURY_KEYS, state.injuriesSelected, INJURY_LABELS, 'inj');

document.querySelectorAll('#orderChips .chip').forEach(el=>{
  el.onclick = ()=>{
    el.classList.toggle('on');
    const k = el.dataset.order;
    if(el.classList.contains('on')) state.ordersSelected.add(k); else state.ordersSelected.delete(k);
  };
});

function toggleAllChips(containerId, selectedSet){
  const wrap = document.getElementById(containerId);
  const chips = wrap.querySelectorAll('.chip');
  const allOn = Array.from(chips).every(c=>c.classList.contains('on'));
  chips.forEach(c=>{
    if(allOn) c.classList.remove('on'); else c.classList.add('on');
    const key = c.dataset.color || c.dataset.amb || c.dataset.ex;
    if(key){ if(!allOn) selectedSet.add(key); else selectedSet.delete(key); }
  });
}

function toggleBlock(name){
  document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${name}"]`).classList.toggle('open');
}
function setModuleState(name, val){
  state.modules[name] = val;
  const tg = document.getElementById('tg-'+name); if(tg) tg.classList.toggle('on', val);
  const blk = document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${name}"]`); if(blk) blk.classList.toggle('active', val);
}
function toggleModule(name){
  if(state.prepPhysique && (PREP_LOCKED_OFF.includes(name) || name==='colors')) return; // verrouillé pendant la préparation physique
  setModuleState(name, !state.modules[name]);
}
function toggleFlag(name){
  state.flags[name] = !state.flags[name];
  document.getElementById('tg-'+name).classList.toggle('on', state.flags[name]);
}
function syncRangeLabel(id){
  document.getElementById(id+'Val').textContent = document.getElementById(id).value + '%';
}

function togglePrepPhysique(){
  state.prepPhysique = !state.prepPhysique;
  document.getElementById('tg-prep').classList.toggle('on', state.prepPhysique);
  document.querySelector('.block[data-block="prep"]').classList.toggle('active', state.prepPhysique);
  if(state.prepPhysique){
    PREP_LOCKED_OFF.forEach(m=> setModuleState(m, false));
    setModuleState('colors', true);
  }
  updateLockVisuals();
}
function updateLockVisuals(){
  PREP_LOCKED_OFF.forEach(m=>{
    const blk = document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${m}"]`);
    if(blk) blk.classList.toggle('locked', state.prepPhysique);
  });
  const colorToggle = document.getElementById('tg-colors');
  if(colorToggle) colorToggle.classList.toggle('locked', state.prepPhysique);
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.toggle('show', false);
}

function setDifficulty(d){
  state.difficulty = d;
  document.querySelectorAll('#difficultySeg > div').forEach(el=>el.classList.toggle('on', el.dataset.diff===d));
  const labels = {facile:'Facile', moyen:'Moyen', difficile:'Difficile'};
  document.getElementById('difficultyLabel').textContent = labels[d];
  applyDifficultyDefaults(d);
}
function applyDifficultyDefaults(d){
  if(state.prepPhysique) return; // la préparation physique garde ses propres réglages
  if(d==='facile'){
    setModuleState('decoys', false);
    setModuleState('multi', false);
    setModuleState('fatigue', false);
  } else if(d==='moyen'){
    setModuleState('fatigue', true);
    setModuleState('decoys', true);
    setModuleState('multi', false);
  } else if(d==='difficile'){
    setModuleState('fatigue', true);
    setModuleState('decoys', true);
    setModuleState('multi', true);
  }
}
// >1 = pauses plus longues (facile) · <1 = pauses plus courtes, plus d'événements (difficile)
function difficultyMult(){
  return state.difficulty==='facile' ? 1.4 : state.difficulty==='difficile' ? 0.6 : 1.0;
}
function difficultyDecoyMult(){
  return state.difficulty==='facile' ? 0.6 : state.difficulty==='difficile' ? 1.7 : 1.0;
}
function setTimeMode(mode){
  state.timeMode = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('#timeSeg > div').forEach(d=>d.classList.toggle('on', d.dataset.timemode===mode));
  document.getElementById('chronoRow').style.display = mode==='chrono' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('timeModeLabel').textContent = mode==='chrono' ? 'Mode chronométré' : 'Mode continu';
}

/* =========================================================
   SAUVEGARDE DE CONFIGURATIONS (localStorage)
   ========================================================= */
const STORAGE_KEY = 'tacti_configs_v2';

function collectConfig(){
  return {
    modules: {...state.modules},
    flags: {...state.flags},
    prepPhysique: state.prepPhysique,
    colorsSelected: Array.from(state.colorsSelected),
    shotCfg: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.shotCfg)),
    ordersSelected: Array.from(state.ordersSelected),
    ambianceSelected: Array.from(state.ambianceSelected),
    prepExercisesSelected: Array.from(state.prepExercisesSelected),
    injuriesSelected: Array.from(state.injuriesSelected),
    timeMode: state.timeMode,
    difficulty: state.difficulty,
    chronoMinutes: parseInt(document.getElementById('chronoMin').value)||5,
    colorMin: +document.getElementById('colorMin').value,
    colorMax: +document.getElementById('colorMax').value,
    shotMin: +document.getElementById('shotMin').value,
    shotMax: +document.getElementById('shotMax').value,
    holdMin: +document.getElementById('holdMin').value,
    holdMax: +document.getElementById('holdMax').value,
    moveMin: +document.getElementById('moveMin').value,
    moveMax: +document.getElementById('moveMax').value,
    orderMin: +document.getElementById('orderMin').value,
    orderMax: +document.getElementById('orderMax').value,
    decoyFreq: +document.getElementById('decoyFreq').value,
    reloadMin: +document.getElementById('reloadMin').value,
    reloadMax: +document.getElementById('reloadMax').value,
    multiFreq: +document.getElementById('multiFreq').value,
    multiBattMin: +document.getElementById('multiBattMin').value,
    multiBattMax: +document.getElementById('multiBattMax').value,
    ambianceVol: +document.getElementById('ambianceVol').value,
    prepSeriesDur: +document.getElementById('prepSeriesDur').value,
    prepColorMin: +document.getElementById('prepColorMin').value,
    prepColorMax: +document.getElementById('prepColorMax').value,
    volVoice: +document.getElementById('volVoice').value,
    volShots: +document.getElementById('volShots').value,
    chainSingle: +document.getElementById('chainSingle').value,
    chainBurst: +document.getElementById('chainBurst').value,
    injuryMin: +document.getElementById('injuryMin').value,
    injuryMax: +document.getElementById('injuryMax').value,
    injuryDurMin: +document.getElementById('injuryDurMin').value,
    injuryDurMax: +document.getElementById('injuryDurMax').value,
  };
}
function applyConfig(cfg){
  state.modules = {...cfg.modules};
  state.flags = {...cfg.flags};
  state.prepPhysique = !!cfg.prepPhysique;
  state.colorsSelected = new Set(cfg.colorsSelected);
  state.shotCfg = migrateShotCfg(cfg);
  state.ordersSelected = new Set(cfg.ordersSelected);
  state.ambianceSelected = new Set(cfg.ambianceSelected || []);
  state.prepExercisesSelected = new Set(cfg.prepExercisesSelected || PREP_EXERCISES);
  state.injuriesSelected = new Set(cfg.injuriesSelected || INJURY_KEYS);
  state.timeMode = cfg.timeMode;
  setDifficulty(cfg.difficulty || 'moyen');
  state.modules = {...cfg.modules}; // setDifficulty peut avoir réappliqué des défauts — on restaure la config exacte
  state.prepPhysique = !!cfg.prepPhysique;

  Object.keys(state.modules).forEach(k=>{
    const tg = document.getElementById('tg-'+k); if(tg) tg.classList.toggle('on', state.modules[k]);
    const blk = document.querySelector(`.block[data-block="${k}"]`); if(blk) blk.classList.toggle('active', state.modules[k]);
  });
  document.getElementById('tg-prep').classList.toggle('on', state.prepPhysique);
  document.querySelector('.block[data-block="prep"]').classList.toggle('active', state.prepPhysique);
  document.getElementById('tg-spatial').classList.toggle('on', state.flags.spatial);
  document.getElementById('tg-randomHold').classList.toggle('on', state.flags.randomHold);
  updateLockVisuals();

  document.querySelectorAll('#colorChips .chip').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('on', state.colorsSelected.has(el.dataset.color)));
  renderWeaponCards();
  document.querySelectorAll('#orderChips .chip').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('on', state.ordersSelected.has(el.dataset.order)));
  document.querySelectorAll('#ambianceChips .chip').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('on', state.ambianceSelected.has(el.dataset.amb)));
  document.querySelectorAll('#prepChips .chip').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('on', state.prepExercisesSelected.has(el.dataset.ex)));
  document.querySelectorAll('#injuryChips .chip').forEach(el=> el.classList.toggle('on', state.injuriesSelected.has(el.dataset.inj)));

  setTimeMode(cfg.timeMode);
  document.getElementById('chronoMin').value = cfg.chronoMinutes;
  document.getElementById('colorMin').value = cfg.colorMin;
  document.getElementById('colorMax').value = cfg.colorMax;
  document.getElementById('shotMin').value = cfg.shotMin;
  document.getElementById('shotMax').value = cfg.shotMax;
  document.getElementById('holdMin').value = cfg.holdMin;
  document.getElementById('holdMax').value = cfg.holdMax;
  document.getElementById('moveMin').value = cfg.moveMin ?? 5;
  document.getElementById('moveMax').value = cfg.moveMax ?? 10;
  document.getElementById('orderMin').value = cfg.orderMin;
  document.getElementById('orderMax').value = cfg.orderMax;
  document.getElementById('decoyFreq').value = cfg.decoyFreq;
  document.getElementById('reloadMin').value = cfg.reloadMin ?? 10;
  document.getElementById('reloadMax').value = cfg.reloadMax ?? 25;
  document.getElementById('multiFreq').value = cfg.multiFreq ?? 40;
  document.getElementById('multiBattMin').value = cfg.multiBattMin ?? 5;
  document.getElementById('multiBattMax').value = cfg.multiBattMax ?? 10;
  document.getElementById('ambianceVol').value = cfg.ambianceVol ?? 30;
  document.getElementById('prepSeriesDur').value = cfg.prepSeriesDur ?? 40;
  document.getElementById('prepColorMin').value = cfg.prepColorMin ?? 10;
  document.getElementById('prepColorMax').value = cfg.prepColorMax ?? 15;
  document.getElementById('volVoice').value = cfg.volVoice;
  document.getElementById('volShots').value = cfg.volShots;
  document.getElementById('chainSingle').value = cfg.chainSingle ?? 35;
  document.getElementById('chainBurst').value = cfg.chainBurst ?? 30;
  document.getElementById('injuryMin').value = cfg.injuryMin ?? 30;
  document.getElementById('injuryMax').value = cfg.injuryMax ?? 30;
  document.getElementById('injuryDurMin').value = cfg.injuryDurMin ?? 30;
  document.getElementById('injuryDurMax').value = cfg.injuryDurMax ?? 30;
  syncRangeLabel('decoyFreq'); syncRangeLabel('volVoice'); syncRangeLabel('volShots'); syncRangeLabel('ambianceVol'); syncRangeLabel('multiFreq'); syncRangeLabel('chainSingle'); syncRangeLabel('chainBurst');
}

function loadAllConfigs(){
  try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || '{}'); }catch(e){ return {}; }
}
function renderSavedList(){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  const wrap = document.getElementById('savedList');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';
  Object.keys(all).forEach(name=>{
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'saveditem';
    row.innerHTML = `<span class="name">${name}</span>
      <span class="acts"><span onclick="loadConfigByName('${name}')">charger</span><span class="del" onclick="deleteConfigByName('${name}')">suppr.</span></span>`;
    wrap.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function saveConfig(){
  const name = document.getElementById('saveName').value.trim();
  if(!name){ return; }
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  all[name] = collectConfig();
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  document.getElementById('saveName').value = '';
  renderSavedList();
}
function loadConfigByName(name){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  if(all[name]) applyConfig(all[name]);
}
function deleteConfigByName(name){
  const all = loadAllConfigs();
  delete all[name];
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(all));
  renderSavedList();
}
function resetConfig(){
  applyConfig({
    modules:{colors:true,shots:true,orders:false,fatigue:false,decoys:false,multi:false,reload:false,ambiance:false,injuries:false},
    flags:{spatial:false,randomHold:true},
    prepPhysique:false,
    colorsSelected:["Rouge","Bleu","Vert","Jaune"],
    shotCfg: defaultShotCfg(),
    ordersSelected:["couche","genoux","accroupi","fige","avancer","reculer","bouger"],
    ambianceSelected:["vent","mer"],
    prepExercisesSelected:["pompes","squats","tractions"],
    injuriesSelected: INJURY_KEYS.slice(),
    timeMode:"continu", difficulty:"moyen", chronoMinutes:5,
    colorMin:15,colorMax:25, shotMin:4,shotMax:10, holdMin:3,holdMax:15, moveMin:5,moveMax:10,
    orderMin:15,orderMax:20, decoyFreq:15, reloadMin:10,reloadMax:25, multiFreq:40, multiBattMin:5,multiBattMax:10,
    ambianceVol:30, prepSeriesDur:40, prepColorMin:10, prepColorMax:15,
    volVoice:100, volShots:80, chainSingle:35, chainBurst:30,
    injuryMin:30, injuryMax:30, injuryDurMin:30, injuryDurMax:30
  });
}
renderSavedList();

/* =========================================================
   MOTEUR AUDIO (Web Audio API — sons synthétisés, 100% local)
   ========================================================= */
let actx = null;
function ensureAudio(){ if(!actx) actx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); return actx; }

function noiseBuffer(ctx, duration){
  const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, Math.max(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*duration)), ctx.sampleRate);
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i] = (Math.random()*2-1);
  return buf;
}

// panner: -1 (gauche) .. 0 (centre) .. 1 (droite)
function makeOutputChain(ctx, gainVal, pan){
  const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = gainVal;
  const panner = ctx.createStereoPanner ? ctx.createStereoPanner() : null;
  if(panner){ panner.pan.value = pan; gain.connect(panner); panner.connect(ctx.destination); return gain; }
  gain.connect(ctx.destination); return gain;
}

function shotVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('volShots').value)/100; }
function voiceVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('volVoice').value)/100; }

/* ---- SONS DE TIR : 5 armes, enregistrements réels validés + synthèse ----
   Armes : AK-47, M16, M249, fusil à pompe, sniper.
   Types : coup par coup (1 ou 3 d'affilée) et rafale (1 ou 2 rafales enchaînées, même arme ou armes différentes). */
const SHOT_SAMPLES = {"ak47_R2":{"gain":0.79,"dur":1.92,"shot":""},"m16_R1":{"gain":0.9,"dur":1.36,"shot":""},"m16_R2":{"gain":0.9,"dur":1.57,"shot":""},"m249_R1":{"gain":0.88,"dur":0.77,"shot":""},"m249_R2":{"gain":0.88,"dur":1.48,"shot":""},"pompe_C":{"gain":1.0,"dur":2.28,"rackAt":2.063,"shot":"","rack":""},"sniper_A":{"gain":1.0,"dur":3.3,"shot":""}};

const SYN_BASE = {crackDur:.05, crack:1, hp:1500, lp:9000, bodyDur:.09, body:.7, bodyF:900,
                  thumpDur:.07, thump:.6, thumpF:250, tailDur:.2, tail:.14, wet:.25, rof:.1, n:6};
const WEAPONS = {
  ak47:  { synth:{hp:500, lp:2500, crack:.4, body:.7, thump:.8, tailDur:.7, tail:.4, wet:1.0, vg:.881}, real:['ak47_R2'] },
  m16:   { synth:{hp:700, lp:3000, crack:.45, body:.7, bodyF:800, thump:.7, tailDur:.7, tail:.4, wet:.9, rof:.075, n:8, vg:1.026}, real:['m16_R1','m16_R2'] },
  m249:  { synth:{hp:500, lp:3000, crack:.45, body:.9, thump:1.1, tailDur:.8, tail:.45, wet:.9, rof:.07, n:12, vg:.992}, real:['m249_R1','m249_R2'] },
  pompe: { sample:'pompe_C' },
  sniper:{ sample:'sniper_A' }
};

let shotBus = null, shotAssets = null;
const shotBufs = {};
function b64buf(b){ const s=atob(b), u=new Uint8Array(s.length); for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++) u[i]=s.charCodeAt(i); return u.buffer; }
function makeIR(ctx, sec, ex){
  const len = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec), buf = ctx.createBuffer(2, len, ctx.sampleRate);
  for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
    const d = buf.getChannelData(c); let s = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<len;i++){ s = s*0.6 + (Math.random()*2-1)*0.4; d[i] = s*Math.pow(1-i/len, ex); }
  }
  return buf;
}
function initShotBus(){
  if(shotBus) return shotBus;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  const comp = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
  comp.threshold.value=-14; comp.knee.value=10; comp.ratio.value=8; comp.attack.value=0.002; comp.release.value=0.12;
  comp.connect(ctx.destination);
  const noise = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate*2, ctx.sampleRate);
  const nd = noise.getChannelData(0); for(let i=0;i<nd.length;i++) nd[i] = Math.random()*2-1;
  const n=1024, curve = new Float32Array(n);
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ const x=i*2/(n-1)-1; curve[i]=Math.tanh(x*3.2)/Math.tanh(3.2); }
  shotBus = { comp, noise, curve, ir: makeIR(ctx, 1.6, 3.2) };
  return shotBus;
}
function loadShotSamples(){
  if(shotAssets) return shotAssets;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  shotAssets = Promise.all(Object.keys(SHOT_SAMPLES).map(async k=>{
    const s = SHOT_SAMPLES[k]; shotBufs[k] = {};
    try{
      shotBufs[k].shot = await ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s.shot));
      if(s.rack) shotBufs[k].rack = await ctx.decodeAudioData(b64buf(s.rack));
    }catch(e){}
  }));
  return shotAssets;
}

// un "évènement" sonore : niveau + spatialisation + réverbération, puis compresseur commun
function makeEvent(pan, wet, vg){
  const ctx = actx; const bus = initShotBus();
  const out = ctx.createGain(); out.gain.value = shotVolume()*0.85*(vg||1);
  if(ctx.createStereoPanner){ const pn = ctx.createStereoPanner(); pn.pan.value = pan; out.connect(pn); pn.connect(bus.comp); }
  else out.connect(bus.comp);
  const input = ctx.createGain(); input.connect(out);
  if(wet>0){
    const w = ctx.createGain(); w.gain.value = wet;
    const cv = ctx.createConvolver(); cv.buffer = bus.ir;
    input.connect(w); w.connect(cv); cv.connect(out);
  }
  return { input, out };
}

const jit = (v,a)=> v*(1 + (Math.random()*2-1)*a);
function nzBurst(t0, out, o){
  const ctx = actx, bus = shotBus;
  const s = ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = bus.noise;
  s.start(t0, Math.random()*(bus.noise.duration - o.dur - 0.1)); s.stop(t0 + o.dur + 0.02);
  let node = s;
  (o.filters||[]).forEach(f=>{
    const b = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); b.type = f.type;
    b.frequency.setValueAtTime(f.f, t0);
    if(f.fEnd) b.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f.fEnd, t0 + o.dur);
    if(f.q !== undefined) b.Q.value = f.q;
    node.connect(b); node = b;
  });
  if(o.drive){ const ws = ctx.createWaveShaper(); ws.curve = bus.curve; node.connect(ws); node = ws; }
  const g = ctx.createGain();
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(o.gain, 0.0002), t0 + (o.attack||0.001));
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + o.dur);
  node.connect(g); g.connect(out);
}
function synthShot(t, out, p){
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.crackDur, attack:.0005, gain:jit(p.crack,.1), drive:true,
    filters:[{type:'highpass', f:jit(p.hp,.05)}, {type:'lowpass', f:p.lp}]});
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.bodyDur, attack:.001, gain:jit(p.body,.1),
    filters:[{type:'bandpass', f:jit(p.bodyF,.05), q:.8}]});
  nzBurst(t, out, {dur:p.thumpDur, attack:.002, gain:jit(p.thump,.1),
    filters:[{type:'lowpass', f:p.thumpF, fEnd:p.thumpF*.35}]});
  nzBurst(t+.01, out, {dur:p.tailDur, attack:.005, gain:p.tail,
    filters:[{type:'lowpass', f:2500, fEnd:600}]});
}
function synthParams(w){ return Object.assign({}, SYN_BASE, WEAPONS[w].synth); }
function synthSingle(w, pan, t){
  const p = synthParams(w), ev = makeEvent(pan, p.wet, p.vg);
  synthShot(t, ev.input, p);
  return p.tailDur + .1;
}
function synthBurst(w, pan, t){
  const p = synthParams(w), ev = makeEvent(pan, p.wet, p.vg);
  const n = Math.max(3, p.n + Math.floor(Math.random()*4) - 1);
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ synthShot(tt, ev.input, p); tt += p.rof*(0.94+Math.random()*0.12); }
  return (tt - t) + p.tailDur;
}

// extrait réel (rafale AK/M16/M249, coup de pompe, coup de sniper) — retourne la durée, 0 si non chargé
function playSmp(key, part, pan, t){
  const b = shotBufs[key] && shotBufs[key][part];
  if(!b) return 0;
  const ctx = actx, ev = makeEvent(pan, 0, 1);
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = b;
  const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = SHOT_SAMPLES[key].gain;
  src.connect(g); g.connect(ev.out); src.start(t);
  return b.duration;
}
function pompeSeq(count, pan, t){
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const d = playSmp('pompe_C','shot',pan,tt);
    if(!d) return 0;
    if(i<count-1){
      const rb = shotBufs.pompe_C.rack, rd = rb ? rb.duration : 0.8;
      if(rb) playSmp('pompe_C','rack',pan,tt+0.9);
      tt += 0.9 + rd + 0.15;
    }
  }
  return (tt - t) + 1.5;
}
function sniperSeq(count, pan, t){
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
    const d = playSmp('sniper_A','shot',pan,tt);
    if(!d) return 0;
    if(i<count-1) tt += 1.6 + Math.random()*0.8;
  }
  return (tt - t) + 2.5;
}

const pickOf = arr => arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];
function chainSingleFreq(){ return (+document.getElementById('chainSingle').value) + fatigueLevel*2; }
function chainBurstFreq(){ return (+document.getElementById('chainBurst').value) + fatigueLevel*2; }

// définition des armes à pistes : id de piste -> libellé + source
const TRACKS = {
  ak47: [['E','Synthé · très lointain','synth'],['R2','Réel · plus lointain','ak47_R2']],
  m16:  [['E','Synthé · lointain','synth'],['R1','Réel · 3 courtes rafales','m16_R1'],['R2','Réel · longue rafale','m16_R2']],
  m249: [['E','Synthé · lointain','synth'],['R1','Réel · courte rafale','m249_R1'],['R2','Réel · rafale moyenne','m249_R2']]
};
const WEAPON_LABELS = {ak47:'AK-47', m16:'M16', m249:'M249', pompe:'Fusil à pompe (Massif)', sniper:'Sniper'};
function defaultShotCfg(){
  return {
    ak47:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R2']},
    m16:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R1','R2']},
    m249:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:['E','R1','R2']},
    pompe:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:[]},
    sniper:{on:true, single:true, burst:true, tracks:[]}
  };
}
function migrateShotCfg(cfg){
  const d = defaultShotCfg();
  if(cfg && cfg.shotCfg){
    Object.keys(d).forEach(w=>{ if(cfg.shotCfg[w]) d[w] = Object.assign(d[w], cfg.shotCfg[w]); });
    return d;
  }
  if(cfg && cfg.weaponsSelected){
    const modes = cfg.shotModesSelected || ['single','burst'];
    Object.keys(d).forEach(w=>{ d[w].on = cfg.weaponsSelected.includes(w); d[w].single = modes.includes('single'); d[w].burst = modes.includes('burst'); });
  }
  return d;
}
function shotCfgValid(){
  return Object.values(state.shotCfg).some(c=> c.on && (c.single || c.burst));
}
function trackSource(w, id){ const t = (TRACKS[w]||[]).find(x=>x[0]===id); return t ? t[2] : null; }

// coup par coup : 1 coup, ou 3 d'affilée selon la fréquence réglée (count forcé pour le test)
function playWeaponSingle(w, pan, t, count){
  if(!count) count = Math.random()*100 < chainSingleFreq() ? 3 : 1;
  if(w==='pompe') return pompeSeq(count, pan, t);
  if(w==='sniper') return sniperSeq(count, pan, t);
  let tt = t;
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++){ synthSingle(w, pan, tt); tt += 0.24 + Math.random()*0.16; }
  return (tt - t) + 0.5;
}
// rafale : piste choisie parmi celles cochées (ou piste forcée pour le test)
function playWeaponBurst(w, pan, t, forced){
  if(w==='pompe') return pompeSeq(2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2), pan, t);
  if(w==='sniper') return sniperSeq(2, pan, t);
  let src;
  if(forced) src = forced;
  else {
    const ids = (state.shotCfg[w].tracks||[]).map(id=>trackSource(w,id)).filter(Boolean);
    src = ids.length ? pickOf(ids) : 'synth';
  }
  if(src!=='synth'){ const d = playSmp(src, 'shot', pan, t); if(d) return d; }
  return synthBurst(w, pan, t);
}

function randomPan(){
  if(!state.flags.spatial) return 0;
  const r = Math.random();
  if(r < 0.34) return -0.85;
  if(r < 0.68) return 0.85;
  return 0; // tir "de face" reste centré
}

function fireShot(){
  const cfg = state.shotCfg;
  const ws = Object.keys(cfg).filter(w=>cfg[w].on && cfg[w].single);
  const wb = Object.keys(cfg).filter(w=>cfg[w].on && cfg[w].burst);
  if(!ws.length && !wb.length) return;
  initShotBus();
  let wSingle = 50, wBurst = 50 + fatigueLevel*5;
  if(state.difficulty==='difficile') wBurst += 18; else if(state.difficulty==='facile') wBurst -= 12;
  const pool = [];
  if(ws.length) for(let i=0;i<Math.max(5,wSingle);i++) pool.push('single');
  if(wb.length) for(let i=0;i<Math.max(5,wBurst);i++)  pool.push('burst');
  const mode = pickOf(pool), pan = randomPan();
  const t0 = actx.currentTime + 0.03;
  if(mode==='single'){ playWeaponSingle(pickOf(ws), pan, t0); return; }
  const w = pickOf(wb);
  const d = playWeaponBurst(w, pan, t0);
  // parfois deux rafales d'affilée : même arme, ou une autre arme à rafale activée
  if(Math.random()*100 < chainBurstFreq()){
    const others = wb.filter(x=>x!==w);
    const w2 = (others.length && Math.random()<0.5) ? pickOf(others) : w;
    playWeaponBurst(w2, pan, t0 + Math.min(d,2.2)*0.9 + 0.5 + Math.random()*0.7);
  }
}

/* ---- écoute / test depuis l'écran de réglages ---- */
function testShot(w, kind, src){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
  initShotBus();
  loadShotSamples().then(()=>{
    const t = ctx.currentTime + 0.05;
    if(kind==='single') playWeaponSingle(w, 0, t, 1);
    else if(kind==='triple') playWeaponSingle(w, 0, t, 3);
    else if(kind==='track') playWeaponBurst(w, 0, t, src);
    else playWeaponBurst(w, 0, t);
  });
}
function renderWeaponCards(){
  const root = document.getElementById('weaponCards');
  if(!root) return;
  root.innerHTML = '';
  const mk = (tag, cls, txt)=>{ const e=document.createElement(tag); if(cls) e.className=cls; if(txt!=null) e.textContent=txt; return e; };
  Object.keys(WEAPON_LABELS).forEach(w=>{
    const c = state.shotCfg[w];
    const card = mk('div', 'wcard'+(c.on?'':' off'));
    const head = mk('div','wcard-head');
    const title = mk('span','chip'+(c.on?' on':''), WEAPON_LABELS[w]);
    title.onclick = ()=>{ c.on = !c.on; renderWeaponCards(); };
    head.appendChild(title);
    const modes = mk('div','chip-row'); modes.style.margin='0';
    [['single','Coup par coup'],['burst', (w==='pompe'||w==='sniper') ? 'Série (2-3 tirs)' : 'Rafale']].forEach(([k,l])=>{
      const m = mk('span','chip'+(c[k]?' on':''), l);
      m.onclick = ()=>{ c[k] = !c[k]; renderWeaponCards(); };
      modes.appendChild(m);
    });
    head.appendChild(modes);
    card.appendChild(head);
    if(TRACKS[w]){
      card.appendChild(mk('div','wlabel','Pistes de rafale (une est tirée au hasard parmi celles cochées)'));
      TRACKS[w].forEach(([id,label,src])=>{
        const row = mk('div','trow');
        const chip = mk('span','chip'+(c.tracks.includes(id)?' on':''), id+' · '+label);
        chip.onclick = ()=>{ const i=c.tracks.indexOf(id); if(i>=0) c.tracks.splice(i,1); else c.tracks.push(id); renderWeaponCards(); };
        const b = mk('button','tbtn','▶'); b.type='button'; b.title='Écouter cette piste';
        b.onclick = ()=> testShot(w,'track',src);
        row.appendChild(chip); row.appendChild(b); card.appendChild(row);
      });
    }
    const tests = mk('div','wtests');
    [['single','▶ 1 coup'],['triple','▶ 3 coups'],['burst', (w==='pompe'||w==='sniper') ? '▶ Série' : '▶ Rafale (au hasard)']].forEach(([k,l])=>{
      const b = mk('button','tbtn',l); b.type='button';
      b.onclick = ()=> testShot(w,k);
      tests.appendChild(b);
    });
    card.appendChild(tests);
    root.appendChild(card);
  });
}

/* voix off — annonces couleurs & ordres, jamais spatialisées */
function speak(text){
  if(!('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;
  const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  u.lang = 'fr-FR'; u.rate = 1.0; u.pitch = 1.0;
  u.volume = voiceVolume();
  window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}

/* drone continu pour "ne pas bouger" uniquement */
let droneNode = null, droneGain = null;
function startDrone(){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  droneNode = ctx.createOscillator(); droneNode.type='sine'; droneNode.frequency.value = 90;
  droneGain = ctx.createGain(); droneGain.gain.value = 0.0001;
  droneNode.connect(droneGain); droneGain.connect(ctx.destination);
  droneNode.start();
  droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.06*voiceVolume()+0.001, ctx.currentTime+0.4);
}
function stopDrone(){
  if(!droneNode) return;
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  droneGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime+0.4);
  const n = droneNode;
  setTimeout(()=>{ try{n.stop();}catch(e){} }, 500);
  droneNode = null;
}

/* ---- AMBIANCE SONORE (boucles synthétisées, 100% locales) ----
   Banque facilement incrémentable : pour ajouter une ambiance, ajouter une clé à AMBIANCE_KEYS / AMBIANCE_LABELS
   et une fonction ambiance<Nom>(ctx, vol) ci-dessous qui retourne { stop() }.
   Pour brancher un jour de vrais fichiers audio libres de droits : remplacer le corps de la fonction par un
   <audio>/AudioBufferSourceNode chargé via fetch() + decodeAudioData() sur un fichier local embarqué. */
const ambianceNodes = {};
function ambianceVolume(){ return (+document.getElementById('ambianceVol').value)/100; }

function ambianceVent(ctx, vol){
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 4); src.loop = true;
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); filter.type='lowpass'; filter.frequency.value=500;
  const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = vol*0.35;
  const lfo = ctx.createOscillator(); lfo.frequency.value=0.08;
  const lfoGain = ctx.createGain(); lfoGain.gain.value=250;
  lfo.connect(lfoGain); lfoGain.connect(filter.frequency);
  src.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  src.start(); lfo.start();
  return { stop(){ try{src.stop(); lfo.stop();}catch(e){} } };
}
function ambianceMer(ctx, vol){
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 4); src.loop = true;
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); filter.type='lowpass'; filter.frequency.value=700;
  const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = vol*0.08;
  const lfo = ctx.createOscillator(); lfo.type='sine'; lfo.frequency.value=0.12;
  const lfoGain = ctx.createGain(); lfoGain.gain.value = vol*0.26;
  lfo.connect(lfoGain); lfoGain.connect(gain.gain);
  src.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  src.start(); lfo.start();
  return { stop(){ try{src.stop(); lfo.stop();}catch(e){} } };
}
function ambianceCirculation(ctx, vol){
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 4); src.loop = true;
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); filter.type='lowpass'; filter.frequency.value=220;
  const gain = ctx.createGain(); gain.gain.value = vol*0.3;
  src.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  src.start();
  let stopped = false;
  function scheduleSwoosh(){
    if(stopped) return;
    const delay = 4000+Math.random()*9000;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(stopped) return;
      const s = ctx.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = noiseBuffer(ctx, 1.2);
      const f2 = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f2.type='bandpass'; f2.frequency.value=500; f2.Q.value=0.6;
      const g2 = ctx.createGain();
      g2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime);
      g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol*0.5, ctx.currentTime+0.5);
      g2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime+1.2);
      s.connect(f2); f2.connect(g2); g2.connect(ctx.destination);
      s.start(); s.stop(ctx.currentTime+1.2);
      scheduleSwoosh();
    }, delay);
  }
  scheduleSwoosh();
  return { stop(){ stopped=true; try{src.stop();}catch(e){} } };
}
function ambianceAnimaux(ctx, vol){
  let stopped = false;
  function chirp(){
    if(stopped) return;
    const delay = 1500+Math.random()*5000;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(stopped) return;
      const o = ctx.createOscillator(); o.type='sine';
      const base = 1800+Math.random()*1200;
      o.frequency.setValueAtTime(base, ctx.currentTime);
      o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(base*0.7, ctx.currentTime+0.09);
      const g = ctx.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol*0.25, ctx.currentTime+0.01);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime+0.1);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
      o.start(); o.stop(ctx.currentTime+0.12);
      chirp();
    }, delay);
  }
  chirp();
  return { stop(){ stopped = true; } };
}
const AMBIANCE_FN = { vent:ambianceVent, mer:ambianceMer, circulation:ambianceCirculation, animaux:ambianceAnimaux };

function startAmbiance(key){
  const ctx = ensureAudio();
  const fn = AMBIANCE_FN[key];
  if(fn) ambianceNodes[key] = fn(ctx, ambianceVolume());
}
function stopAllAmbiance(){
  Object.keys(ambianceNodes).forEach(k=>{ try{ambianceNodes[k].stop();}catch(e){} delete ambianceNodes[k]; });
}

/* =========================================================
   MOTEUR DE SESSION
   ========================================================= */
const ORDER_LABELS = {
  couche:'Couché', genoux:'À genoux', accroupi:'Accroupi', fige:'Ne pas bouger',
  avancer:'Avancer', reculer:'Reculer', bouger:'Bouger'
};
const MOVE_ORDERS = ['avancer','reculer','bouger'];
const BLOCKING_ORDERS = ['fige', ...MOVE_ORDERS];

const COLOR_HEX = {Rouge:'#7a1f18',Bleu:'#173d6b',Vert:'#1f5c26',Jaune:'#7a6a12',Orange:'#7a4712',Violet:'#4a1f6b',Noir:'#2b2b2b',Blanc:'#dedad0'};
function colorToHex(name){ return COLOR_HEX[name]; }
function colorToTextColor(name){ return name==='Blanc' ? '#141712' : 'rgba(255,255,255,.92)'; }

let sessionTimers = [];
let running = false, paused = false;
let sessionStartTime = 0, pauseAccum = 0, pauseStartedAt = 0;
let chronoTotalMs = 0;
let fatigueLevel = 0;
let fatigueTicker = null;
let clockTicker = null;
const blockReasons = new Set(); // bloque uniquement les annonces de couleur ('order' | 'reload')
let blockLabel = '';

let prepCurrentExercise = null;
let prepSeriesEndAt = 0;
let prepDisplayTicker = null;

function clearAllTimers(){ sessionTimers.forEach(t=>clearTimeout(t)); sessionTimers = []; }
function schedule(fn, delayMs){ const id = setTimeout(fn, delayMs); sessionTimers.push(id); return id; }
function randRange(min,max){ return min + Math.random()*(max-min); }
function fatigueMult(){ return Math.max(0.15, 1 - (fatigueLevel*0.10)); }

function addBlock(reason, label){ blockReasons.add(reason); if(label) blockLabel = label; updateStatusLine(); }
function removeBlock(reason){ blockReasons.delete(reason); if(blockReasons.size===0) blockLabel=''; updateStatusLine(); }

function startSession(){
  if(state.modules.colors && state.colorsSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une couleur, ou désactivez le module Cibles/Couleurs.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.shots && !shotCfgValid()){
    alert("Activez au moins une arme avec un type de tir (coup par coup / rafale), ou désactivez le module Sons de tir.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.ambiance && state.ambianceSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une ambiance, ou désactivez le module Ambiance sonore.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.prepPhysique && state.prepExercisesSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins un exercice pour la préparation physique.");
    return;
  }
  if(state.modules.injuries && state.injuriesSelected.size===0){
    alert("Sélectionnez au moins une blessure, ou désactivez le module Blessures simulées.");
    return;
  }
  ensureAudio();
  if(actx.state==='suspended') actx.resume();
  initShotBus(); loadShotSamples();

  fatigueLevel = 0; paused = false; running = true;
  blockReasons.clear(); blockLabel = '';
  pauseAccum = 0; sessionStartTime = Date.now();

  chronoTotalMs = state.timeMode==='chrono' ? (parseInt(document.getElementById('chronoMin').value)||5)*60000 : 0;

  document.getElementById('session').classList.add('live');
  document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('sessHint').textContent = 'SESSION EN COURS';
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.toggle('show', state.prepPhysique);
  updateStatusLine();

  clockTicker = setInterval(updateClock, 250);

  if(state.modules.fatigue && !state.prepPhysique){
    fatigueTicker = setInterval(()=>{
      if(paused) return;
      fatigueLevel = Math.min(9, fatigueLevel+1);
      updateStatusLine();
    }, 30000);
  }

  if(state.modules.ambiance){
    Array.from(state.ambianceSelected).forEach(k=> startAmbiance(k));
  }

  if(state.modules.shots && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextShot();
  if(state.modules.colors) scheduleNextColor();
  if(state.modules.orders && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextOrder();
  if(state.modules.decoys && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextDecoy();
  if(state.modules.reload && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextReload();
  if(state.modules.injuries && !state.prepPhysique) scheduleNextInjury();
  if(state.prepPhysique) startPrepSeries();

  if('mediaSession' in navigator){
    try{
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('play', ()=>{ if(paused) togglePause(); });
      navigator.mediaSession.setActionHandler('pause', ()=>{ if(!paused) togglePause(); });
      navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = 'playing';
    }catch(e){}
  }
}

function updateStatusLine(){
  const el = document.getElementById('sessStatus');
  const f = state.modules.fatigue ? `fatigue: +${fatigueLevel*10}%` : 'fatigue: off';
  el.textContent = f + (blockLabel ? '\n'+blockLabel : '');
}

function updateClock(){
  const el = document.getElementById('sessTimer');
  if(state.prepPhysique){
    const remain = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((prepSeriesEndAt - Date.now())/1000));
    const mm = String(Math.floor(remain/60)).padStart(2,'0');
    const ss = String(remain%60).padStart(2,'0');
    document.getElementById('sessExercise').textContent = `${PREP_LABELS[prepCurrentExercise]||''} — ${mm}:${ss}`;
  }
  if(state.timeMode==='continu'){ el.textContent = '∞'; return; }
  const elapsed = (Date.now() - sessionStartTime - pauseAccum);
  const remain = Math.max(0, chronoTotalMs - elapsed);
  const s = Math.ceil(remain/1000);
  const mm = String(Math.floor(s/60)).padStart(2,'0');
  const ss = String(s%60).padStart(2,'0');
  el.textContent = `${mm}:${ss}`;
  if(remain<=0) quitSession();
}

/* ---- SONS DE TIR ---- */
function scheduleNextShot(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('shotMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('shotMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * fatigueMult() * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running){ fireShot(); }
    scheduleNextShot();
  }, delay);
}

/* ---- COULEURS ---- */
function colorIntervalRange(){
  if(state.prepPhysique) return [+document.getElementById('prepColorMin').value, +document.getElementById('prepColorMax').value];
  return [+document.getElementById('colorMin').value, +document.getElementById('colorMax').value];
}
function scheduleNextColor(){
  if(!running) return;
  const [min,max] = colorIntervalRange();
  const mult = state.prepPhysique ? 1 : (fatigueMult() * difficultyMult());
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * mult;
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running && blockReasons.size===0){
      const multiFreq = state.modules.multi ? (+document.getElementById('multiFreq').value) : 0;
      if(state.modules.multi && !state.prepPhysique && Math.random()*100 < multiFreq){
        fireMultiTarget(()=> scheduleNextColor());
        return;
      } else {
        fireSingleTarget();
      }
    }
    scheduleNextColor();
  }, delay);
}
function fireSingleTarget(){
  const arr = Array.from(state.colorsSelected);
  if(arr.length===0) return;
  const c = arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)];
  announceColor(c);
}
function fireMultiTarget(afterBattement){
  const arr = Array.from(state.colorsSelected);
  if(arr.length===0){ afterBattement(); return; }
  const count = Math.min(arr.length, 2 + Math.floor(Math.random()*2)); // 2 ou 3
  const shuffled = [...arr].sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5).slice(0,count);
  shuffled.forEach((c,i)=>{
    schedule(()=> announceColor(c), i*1300);
  });
  const battMin = +document.getElementById('multiBattMin').value, battMax = +document.getElementById('multiBattMax').value;
  const totalDelay = shuffled.length*1300 + randRange(battMin,battMax)*1000;
  schedule(afterBattement, totalDelay);
}
function announceColor(c){
  speak(c);
  flashWord(c, false);
}
function flashWord(text, small){
  const w = document.getElementById('sessWord');
  w.textContent = text;
  w.classList.toggle('small', !!small);
  w.style.color = colorToTextColor(text);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = colorToHex(text) || '#111';
  clearTimeout(window.__wordClear);
  window.__wordClear = setTimeout(()=>{
    document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#000';
    document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent='';
  }, 1600);
}

/* ---- LEURRES : indépendants, mêmes annonces, sans lien avec le terrain réel ---- */
function scheduleNextDecoy(){
  if(!running) return;
  const delay = randRange(18,35) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running && blockReasons.size===0){
      const freq = ((+document.getElementById('decoyFreq').value) + fatigueLevel*5) * difficultyDecoyMult();
      if(Math.random()*100 < freq){
        const c = ALL_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random()*ALL_COLORS.length)];
        announceColor(c); // visuellement indiscernable — l'utilisateur doit vérifier le terrain
      }
    }
    scheduleNextDecoy();
  }, delay);
}

/* ---- ORDRES DE MOUVEMENT ---- */
function scheduleNextOrder(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('orderMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('orderMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      const pool = Array.from(state.ordersSelected);
      if(pool.length>0){
        triggerOrder(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
        return; // triggerOrder se charge de reprogrammer après sa propre durée
      }
    }
    scheduleNextOrder();
  }, delay);
}
function triggerOrder(o){
  const isMove = MOVE_ORDERS.includes(o);
  const isBlocking = BLOCKING_ORDERS.includes(o);
  let duration;
  if(isMove){
    const mn = +document.getElementById('moveMin').value, mx = +document.getElementById('moveMax').value;
    duration = randRange(mn,mx);
  } else {
    const hn = +document.getElementById('holdMin').value, hx = +document.getElementById('holdMax').value;
    duration = state.flags.randomHold ? randRange(hn,hx) : hn;
  }
  speak(ORDER_LABELS[o]);
  flashWord(ORDER_LABELS[o], true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';

  if(isBlocking) addBlock('order', ORDER_LABELS[o].toUpperCase());
  if(o==='fige') startDrone();

  schedule(()=>{
    if(o==='fige') stopDrone();
    if(isBlocking) removeBlock('order');
    scheduleNextOrder();
  }, duration*1000);
}

/* ---- RECHARGEMENT ---- */
function scheduleNextReload(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('reloadMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('reloadMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000;
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      speak('Reloading');
      flashWord('Reloading', true);
      document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';
      addBlock('reload', 'RELOADING');
      schedule(()=> removeBlock('reload'), 3000);
    }
    scheduleNextReload();
  }, delay);
}

/* ---- BLESSURES SIMULÉES ---- */
function scheduleNextInjury(){
  if(!running) return;
  const min = +document.getElementById('injuryMin').value, max = +document.getElementById('injuryMax').value;
  const delay = randRange(min,max) * 1000 * difficultyMult();
  schedule(()=>{
    if(!paused && running){
      const pool = Array.from(state.injuriesSelected);
      if(pool.length>0){
        triggerInjury(pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]);
        return; // triggerInjury se charge de reprogrammer après sa propre durée
      }
    }
    scheduleNextInjury();
  }, delay);
}
function triggerInjury(inj){
  const dn = +document.getElementById('injuryDurMin').value, dx = +document.getElementById('injuryDurMax').value;
  const duration = randRange(dn,dx);
  speak(INJURY_LABELS[inj]);
  flashWord(INJURY_LABELS[inj], true);
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#111';

  addBlock('injury', INJURY_LABELS[inj].toUpperCase());

  schedule(()=>{
    removeBlock('injury');
    scheduleNextInjury();
  }, duration*1000);
}

/* ---- PRÉPARATION PHYSIQUE ---- */
function startPrepSeries(){
  if(!running) return;
  const pool = Array.from(state.prepExercisesSelected);
  if(pool.length===0) return;
  prepCurrentExercise = pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
  const dur = (+document.getElementById('prepSeriesDur').value)||40;
  prepSeriesEndAt = Date.now() + dur*1000;
  schedule(()=>{ if(running) startPrepSeries(); }, dur*1000);
}

/* ---- PAUSE / QUIT ---- */
function togglePause(){
  paused = !paused;
  document.getElementById('session').classList.toggle('paused', paused);
  document.getElementById('pauseBtn').textContent = paused ? 'Reprendre' : 'Pause';
  if(paused){
    pauseStartedAt = Date.now();
    window.speechSynthesis && window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    if(actx) actx.suspend();
  } else {
    pauseAccum += Date.now() - pauseStartedAt;
    if(actx) actx.resume();
  }
  if('mediaSession' in navigator) navigator.mediaSession.playbackState = paused ? 'paused' : 'playing';
}
function quitSession(){
  running = false;
  clearAllTimers();
  clearInterval(fatigueTicker);
  clearInterval(clockTicker);
  stopDrone();
  stopAllAmbiance();
  blockReasons.clear(); blockLabel = '';
  window.speechSynthesis && window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
  document.getElementById('session').classList.remove('live','paused');
  document.getElementById('sessWord').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('sessExercise').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('session').style.backgroundColor = '#000';
}

renderWeaponCards();
</script>
</body>
</html>
